lines.text: Many learners say: If I will have time, I will go.
Better: If I have time, I will go.
Rains! If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.

data.wrong: If I will have time, I will go.
data.right: If I have time, I will go.

quiz.stem: If it ___ tomorrow, I will stay home.

native.tip: Câu “nếu… thì sẽ…” khiến nhiều bạn thêm “will” vào cả hai vế, nhưng sau “if” tiếng Anh không dùng “will”.
native.caption: Bạn có hay nói “If I will have time, I will go.” không? 🤔 Sau “if” không dùng “will”: “If I have time, I will go.” Nghe thầy Carlos đọc rồi lặp lại nhé! Luyện thêm trong app Lexkite.

en.tip: Many learners add “will” to both parts, but English does not use “will” after “if”.
en.caption: Do you often say this? “If I will have time, I will go.” After “if”, do not use “will”: “If I have time, I will go.” Listen to Carlos read it, then repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
